conversation_guard.wrong_role_action: Do not execute the task or switch roles. Direct the user to the correct existing or fresh role conversation using the generic Process command.
conversation_guard.shared_context_rule: Cross-role facts must come through durable client state or another declared authoritative source; do not carry role-local assumptions across conversations.

next_step_contract.generic_command: Check Tenshodo-Process and execute the current engagement step for <client>.

precedence_rule: Live authoritative client systems and live client durable state override this packet if they differ.
recovery_rule: If this packet is stale, reconcile from the client state and repair the packet before relying on it again.

workstream_routing.explicit_command_pattern: Check Tenshodo-Process and continue the <workstream> workstream for <client>.
workstream_routing.resolution_rule: Resolve conversation role binding first. Then use an explicitly named workstream, the single workstream assigned to the bound role, a declared default, or the single remaining eligible active workstream. Ask only when multiple eligible workstreams remain.

environment_topology.rule: These are pointers only. Resolve provider/tenant/environment/service/location identity from client durable state before connector-based discovery; never treat provider name alone as sufficient scope.
